# Data attribution

ChurnIQ uses derived outputs from IBM's Telco sample, https://github.com/IBM/telco-customer-churn-on-icp4d , revision d5371f5d83a446ad5673cbcca3b814b926491f8a. Repository license Apache-2.0, included alongside this file. The source CSV is downloaded on demand, not redistributed in Git. Our derived summaries/predictions and transformations are modifications; no endorsement or company employment is implied.

MarketScope and DemandCast derive aggregate analysis from Chen, D. (2012), Online Retail II, UCI Machine Learning Repository, https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D . Licensed CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Changes: deduplication, merchandise filtering, monetary normalization, dimensional modeling, aggregation and forecasting. Raw workbook/customer records are not redistributed in Git. No company affiliation is claimed.

ExperimentLab's records are generated by this project's seeded simulation, not sourced user behavior.
